title: Sanger Tree of Life Sample Homogenisation: PowerMash
author: Amy Denton

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample into a sterile 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube and add the lysis buffer required for the downstream protocol.

steps.title: Assemble PowerMasher II Device
steps.instruction: Attach the sterile BioMasher pestle to the PowerMasher II tissue disruptor.

substeps.instruction: Avoid contact with the end of the pestle that will contact the sample to prevent contamination.

steps.title: Disrupt Sample
steps.instruction: Disrupt the sample in the lysis buffer using the PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and sterile BioMasher pestle.

substeps.instruction: Place the pestle into the BioMasher tube against the sample.
Apply gentle pressure to keep the sample between the pestle and the tube wall.
Squeeze the trigger of the PowerMasher II tissue disruptor to activate it.
Continue for approximately 30 seconds to 1 minute (depending on tissue type) until no large pieces remain or the sample cannot be disrupted further.
Gently move the pestle up and down during the process to encourage sample movement and prevent it from sticking to the bottom.

steps.title: Clean and Dispose of Equipment
steps.instruction: Remove the pestle from the BioMasher tube and disconnect it from the PowerMasher tissue disruptor II.

substeps.instruction: If tissue remains on the pestle, gently wipe the pestle tip on the rim of the BioMasher tube to remove it.
Dispose of the pestle in biological waste.

steps.title: Proceed to Downstream Protocol
steps.instruction: Proceed with the powermashed sample to the next step of the tissue's downstream protocol, such as DNA or RNA extraction.
